clue.text: Becoming endlessly crowded and irregular

parts.note: becoming, as in suitable or seemly, means fit

indicators.note: endlessly says the word for crowded loses its final letter

parts.note: crowded means full

explanation.surface: Something growing more packed and more erratic, like a busy commuter train.
explanation.definitionFit: Fitful describes something that comes in bursts and stops, so it is a synonym of irregular.

clue.text: Well-known storyteller takes notes in advance

indicators.note: in advance says the notes come before the storyteller in the answer

parts.note: fa is a note of the sol-fa scale
mi is another note of the sol-fa scale
a liar tells stories, in the sense of untruths

explanation.surface: A famous author jots down notes before writing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'notes' gives two pieces, FA and MI, from the do-re-mi scale; 'takes' is a link and 'in advance' places them ahead of LIAR.
explanation.definitionFit: Something familiar is commonly known or recognised, a straightforward synonym.

clue.text: Roman historian abandoned son on the Rubicon's banks without saying much

indicators.note: abandoned says the son, S, is left out of the historian's name

parts.note: Tacitus was a historian of imperial Rome

indicators.note: the banks of a word are its outside letters, here R and N

explanation.surface: A Roman writer leaves his son behind at the Rubicon and stays silent.
explanation.definitionFit: A taciturn person is reserved and speaks little, which the phrase describes exactly.

clue.text: He expects lots of interest from American university about original research

parts.note: re means about, as in a letter heading

indicators.note: original picks the first letter, the origin of the word research

explanation.surface: An academic expects a lot of interest in a US university's new research.
explanation.walkthrough: 'interest' looks academic but is money charged on a loan.
explanation.definitionFit: A moneylender charging excessive rates on loans expects large returns, the financial sense of interest.

clue.text: One's free to convert as predicted

indicators.note: to convert something is to change its form, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone at liberty to change religion, just as was expected.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to convert' rearranges the letters of ONES FREE; 'as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something foreseen was known beforehand, so it was predicted.

clue.text: Nothing's left over from capital

parts.note: nothing is O, a zero, with the S of the possessive kept
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over

explanation.surface: Nothing remains from the original capital sum.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket an over is a set of six balls, abbreviated O on scorecards.
explanation.definitionFit: Oslo is the capital city of Norway, an example of a capital.

clue.text: Qualified to become important setter taken up in women's magazine

indicators.note: in says the reversed pieces sit inside the magazine's name

parts.note: Elle is a well-known women's fashion magazine

indicators.note: taken up in a down clue means read upwards, so backwards

parts.note: big means important
the setter refers to themself as I

explanation.surface: A puzzle setter becomes famous enough to be featured in a glossy magazine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'taken up' reads the two pieces upwards, giving IGIB, since this is a down clue; 'to become' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Being eligible means meeting the conditions, so being qualified for something.

clue.text: Times shows difficulty in choosing a device for deleting things

parts.note: eras are periods or times
er is the sound of hesitation when someone cannot decide

explanation.surface: A newspaper shows how hard it is to pick a tool for removing content.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Times' suggests the newspaper but means periods.
explanation.definitionFit: A rubber or eraser is the tool used to remove pencil marks, so it deletes things.

clue.text: Compose a short statement welcoming volunteers

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so one piece contains the other

parts.note: a note is a brief written message or statement
TA is the Territorial Army, the British volunteer reserve force

explanation.surface: Writing a brief speech to greet a group of helpers.
explanation.walkthrough: The Territorial Army (TA) is Britain's part-time volunteer army reserve.
explanation.definitionFit: To notate is to write music or set something down in notation, a sense of compose.

clue.text: Slimy froth runs back round front of outbuildings

indicators.note: round says the reversed froth wraps around the letter taken
runs back means the word for froth is read in reverse

parts.note: scum is a froth on a liquid's surface

indicators.note: front of picks the first letter of outbuildings

explanation.surface: Nasty foam trickles back around the sheds.
explanation.walkthrough: 'runs back' turns SCUM into MUCS, which goes round O to give MUC-O-S.
explanation.definitionFit: Mucous describes something like mucus, so it is slimy.

clue.text: He goes to court to demand a social worker

parts.note: to claim is to demand as a right
an ant is a social insect and a worker

explanation.surface: A litigant sues to get a council social worker assigned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'social worker' sounds like a care professional, but it is the ant, a social insect with a worker caste.
explanation.definitionFit: A claimant brings a case before a court, so this is a description of a litigant.

clue.text: Exult at commanding officer being overwhelmed by crude jeer

indicators.note: being overwhelmed by means swamped, so surrounded by the other piece
crude means rough and unrefined, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: OIC stands for officer in charge, the one commanding

explanation.surface: Celebrating while the boss is drowned out by rude jeers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crude' gives the rearrangement REJE, split around the officer; OIC (officer in charge) is a military abbreviation. 'at' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To rejoice is to feel or show great joy, a synonym of exult.

clue.text: Reproduced false information about dry wine

indicators.note: about says the word for false information goes round the other piece

parts.note: a lie is false information
TT means teetotal, so dry
red is wine

explanation.surface: Copied misinformation about a sec wine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reproduced' suggests copying, but means gave birth to young.
explanation.definitionFit: An animal that littered gave birth to a litter of young, so it reproduced.

clue.text: One group follows bishop in split

indicators.note: follows says the one and the group come after the bishop

parts.note: B is the chess abbreviation for bishop
I is the Roman numeral one
a sect is a religious group

explanation.surface: A church splits when a breakaway faction forms behind a bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: To bisect is to cut into two halves, a precise kind of split.

clue.text: Regularly wants agency worker with time to make an effort

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter of wants, the second and fourth

parts.note: a temp is a temporary worker from an agency

explanation.surface: An agency temp with a deadline keeps wanting to try hard.
explanation.definitionFit: To attempt something is to try, which is making an effort.

clue.text: A means to substitute right for a wrong

indicators.note: to substitute says one letter takes the place of another

parts.note: a means is a way of doing something

explanation.surface: A method of putting right a wrong.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to substitute right for a' swaps an A in AWAY for R.
explanation.definitionFit: Awry means off course or amiss, so things gone awry have gone wrong.

clue.text: Unfriendly crowd on Martinique say

parts.note: a host is a great crowd
Martinique is an example of an île, the French word for island

explanation.surface: A cold welcome from the crowd on a Caribbean island.
explanation.walkthrough: Martinique is French territory, so it is an île; 'say' marks it as an example; 'on' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Hostile means antagonistic or unfriendly, a direct synonym.

clue.text: One quits to resolve dispute

indicators.note: to resolve means to break down into parts, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone resigns to settle an argument.
explanation.definitionFit: To question a claim is to dispute or challenge it.

clue.text: DIY is something to do after school

definitions.meaning: do-it-yourself jobs about the house are work at home
tasks set by a teacher to be finished outside lessons

explanation.surface: Home improvement is a chore to tackle once the school day is over.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both domestic jobs and school assignments done at home.

clue.text: Factional divide is the beginnings of anarchy

parts.note: to part is to divide

indicators.note: the beginnings of takes the opening letters, here the first two, of anarchy

explanation.surface: A split within a faction is the start of chaos.
explanation.definitionFit: Partisan means strongly supporting one side, which is factional.

clue.text: To hack into pieces is more macho

definitions.meaning: to chop up carcasses or bodies roughly
the comparative of butch, meaning manly

explanation.surface: Chopping things up is the more manly job.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the verb for cutting up meat crudely and the comparative of butch.

clue.text: Seen in mouldings of antique item of furniture

indicators.note: seen in says the answer is visible inside the following words

explanation.surface: Carved decoration on an old chair or settee.
explanation.definitionFit: A sofa is a long upholstered seat, an example of furniture.

clue.text: Fed up with European alternative technology failure

indicators.note: up in a down clue means the word is read upwards, so reversed

parts.note: AT is short for alternative technology

explanation.surface: Someone tired of green technology that does not work.
explanation.definitionFit: A defeat is a loss or a failure to win.

clue.text: Bent journalist under pressure after conflict

indicators.note: after says the pressure comes later than the conflict
under in a down clue puts the journalist below the pressure

parts.note: war is armed conflict
P is the physics symbol for pressure
ED is an editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: A corrupt reporter cracks under the strain of covering a war.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bent' reads as crooked but here means twisted out of shape.
explanation.definitionFit: Warped means twisted out of shape, so bent.

clue.text: In this manner Romeo's right to express pain and grief

parts.note: so means in this manner, thus
Romeo is R in the NATO phonetic alphabet
ow is the cry people give when hurt

explanation.surface: Like Shakespeare's Romeo, voicing anguish and heartbreak.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Romeo' recalls the tragic lover, but it is the radio code word for R.
explanation.definitionFit: Sorrow is deep sadness, a synonym of grief.

clue.text: Finally forgive failure to pass

indicators.note: finally picks the last letter of forgive

parts.note: a lapse is a slip or failure

explanation.surface: At last pardoning someone for not passing an exam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pass' looks like the exam result, but it is time going by.
explanation.definitionFit: When time elapses it passes or slips by.

clue.text: He's against surgery on pet with broken back possibly

parts.note: an op is an operation, or surgery

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters before it may be rearranged into another order
back picks the end letter of the word broken

explanation.surface: A vet operating on an injured animal is against it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broken back' looks like the injury, but 'back' takes the final N of 'broken', and 'possibly' mixes it with the other two words. 'with' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: An opponent is someone on the opposing side, who stands against you.

clue.text: Damsel in a reduced state

definitions.meaning: a young unmarried woman, a maiden
a shortened form of Mississippi, a US state

explanation.surface: A young woman who has fallen on hard times.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is a title for a young woman and also a short form of Mississippi, an American state.

clue.text: Outspoken priest allowed to stand by beheaded king

indicators.note: to stand by means to sit beside, so the pieces go next to each other
beheaded means the first letter of the word for king is cut off

parts.note: rex is Latin for king
licit means lawful or allowed

explanation.surface: A blunt cleric is permitted to support an executed monarch.
explanation.definitionFit: Explicit means stated clearly and plainly, so outspoken.

clue.text: Potential husbands reportedly became extremely magnanimous

indicators.note: reportedly says the pieces are spoken and the answer is what is heard

parts.note: grew means became; said aloud it gives the first syllable

indicators.note: extremely picks the outside letters, the extremes, of magnanimous

explanation.surface: Prospective bridegrooms said to have turned very generous.
explanation.definitionFit: Grooms are men about to be married, so husbands to be.

clue.text: Cook insisted it means keeping things in order

indicators.note: to cook figures is to fiddle them, so these letters are reworked

explanation.surface: A chef insists that a kitchen must be kept neat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Cook' looks like a chef but is the anagram signal; 'it means' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Tidiness is neatness, the state of having things arranged in order.

clue.text: Rouse watch to go after American navy

indicators.note: to go after places the watch after the American

parts.note: a wake is a watch kept over a body

explanation.surface: Wake someone up for a sentry watch after the US navy.
explanation.definitionFit: To awaken someone is to wake or stir them, a synonym of rouse.
